**Exploring button concepts**

I'm thinking about the main concept of "button" in H14, and wondering if it relates to action or usage. Could "button eye" refer to something like a "one-eyed monster"? The idea of "blink" comes to mind—using one eye to wink could suggest an action, maybe something about opening or closing an interface. I'm curious if there's an electronic aspect to this, too. It's interesting how these different interpretations can overlap and connect!
